server.name: io.github.VictoriaMetrics/mcp-victoriametrics
server.description: MCP Server for VictoriaMetrics. Provides integration with VictoriaMetrics API and documentation

environmentVariables.description: URL to VictoriaMetrics instance (it should be root URL of vmsingle or vmselect), for example http://localhost:8428 or https://play.victoriametrics.com
environmentVariables.name: VM_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Type of VictoriaMetrics instance (single / cluster)
environmentVariables.name: VM_INSTANCE_TYPE

environmentVariables.description: Authentication token for VictoriaMetrics API
environmentVariables.name: VM_INSTANCE_BEARER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Optional: API key from VictoriaMetrics Cloud Console (if you have deployment in VictoriaMetrics Cloud)
environmentVariables.name: VMC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Disable all resources (documentation tool will continue to work)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLE_RESOURCES

environmentVariables.description: HTTP header names to forward from incoming MCP requests to VictoriaMetrics (comma-separated list). Overrides VM_INSTANCE_HEADERS on collision.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PASSTHROUGH_HEADERS

server.name: io.github.VictoriaMetrics/mcp-vmanomaly
server.description: MCP Server for vmanomaly - VictoriaMetrics anomaly detection

environmentVariables.description: vmanomaly server endpoint URL (e.g., http://localhost:8490)
environmentVariables.name: VMANOMALY_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for authenticating with vmanomaly API
environmentVariables.name: VMANOMALY_BEARER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Custom HTTP headers for vmanomaly requests (comma-separated key=value pairs, e.g., X-Custom-Header=value1,X-Another=value2)
environmentVariables.name: VMANOMALY_HEADERS

environmentVariables.description: MCP server mode: stdio (default), sse, or http
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SERVER_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Listen address for SSE/HTTP modes (default: localhost:8080)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LISTEN_ADDR

environmentVariables.description: Log level: debug, info (default), warn, or error
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Log file path (empty = stderr)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Heartbeat interval for HTTP mode (default: 30s)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL

environmentVariables.description: Disable embedded documentation resources
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLE_RESOURCES

server.name: io.github.Vortx-AI/emem
server.description: Content-addressed, ed25519-signed memory of every place on Earth. Apache-2.0, no keys for reads.
server.title: emem — Earth memory protocol

environmentVariables.description: Bind address for the HTTP server. Defaults to 0.0.0.0:5051 inside the container.
environmentVariables.name: EMEM_BIND

environmentVariables.description: Path to the persistent data directory (sled cache + ed25519 identity). Mount a volume here.
environmentVariables.name: EMEM_DATA

environmentVariables.description: Optional canonical origin for self-referencing URLs in MCP responses (e.g. https://emem.dev). When unset the server falls back to urn:emem.
environmentVariables.name: EMEM_PUBLIC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hostnames for built-in Let's Encrypt ACME (TLS-ALPN-01). When set, the server binds 0.0.0.0:443 instead of EMEM_BIND.
environmentVariables.name: EMEM_TLS_DOMAINS
